imports: from tests.integration.editor_click_support import editor_journey, navigation_journey, rejected_editor_journey, nested_click_journey

scenarios.name: real_extension_editor_rejection_no_replay
scenarios.title: Stop after the application rejects a full document replacement
scenarios.workflow: Load actual Monaco with a controlled application restoring the original document -> discover proxy -> request replacement plus Enter -> observe full model mismatch -> one editor edit and one application restoration -> no typing fallback or Enter
scenarios.user_problem: Verification failure must not replay a destructive write or submit the wrong document.

scenarios.name: cdp_editor_rejection_no_replay
scenarios.title: Preserve rejected editor content without replay in CDP
scenarios.workflow: Load real editor with application restoration -> discover -> replace plus Enter -> verify mismatch -> no second write and no Enter
scenarios.user_problem: Both transports must stop on an application-rejected full document edit.

scenarios.name: real_extension_monaco_exact_document
scenarios.title: Replace a real Monaco document without retrying its input proxy
scenarios.workflow: Load official Monaco with an existing long document -> discover proxy ref -> fill seven-scope JSON through the real CLI -> verify one full model edit -> fill long JSON through Python -> preserve second editor and ordinary fields
scenarios.user_problem: A proxy textarea must never cause duplicate JSON documents or a false verified result.

scenarios.name: real_extension_private_editor_refused
scenarios.title: Preserve an editor whose full model is unavailable
scenarios.workflow: Load actual editor with private model API -> discover proxy -> request real CLI replacement and Enter -> nonzero unsupported result -> no input or model change
scenarios.user_problem: Unknown editor models require an explicit unsupported result rather than destructive fallback or accidental submission.

scenarios.name: real_extension_collapsed_navigation
scenarios.title: Refuse hidden and covered nav targets, then activate the visible item once
scenarios.workflow: Discover collapsed child -> refuse ref/text/id/xpath and actual CLI clicks without input -> refuse overlay -> expand real menu -> one trusted navigation -> one ordinary non-navigation action
scenarios.user_problem: A hidden link must not receive a verified success from unrelated focus changes or synthetic fallback.

scenarios.name: cdp_monaco_exact_document
scenarios.title: Replace real Monaco JSON using standalone Chrome
scenarios.workflow: Discover the real proxy textarea -> replace existing JSON -> verify entire long model -> preserve independent editor -> verify ordinary input/textarea
scenarios.user_problem: Both transports must share safe verified-fill behavior.

scenarios.name: cdp_private_editor_refused
scenarios.title: Refuse an unverifiable Monaco model in standalone Chrome
scenarios.workflow: Discover real Monaco without a public model API -> request replacement and Enter -> refuse without document changes -> inspect full model and ledger
scenarios.user_problem: Standalone mode must not corrupt editor proxies or submit unverifiable content.

scenarios.name: cdp_collapsed_navigation
scenarios.title: Check actual visible hit targets in standalone Chrome
scenarios.workflow: Discover hidden link -> reject ref/text clicks and overlay without events -> expand menu -> one trusted navigation -> one visible action without navigation
scenarios.user_problem: Hidden geometry and unrelated focus must not produce a verified click receipt.

scenarios.name: real_extension_nested_hit_targets
scenarios.title: Preserve trusted clicks in scaled iframes and open/closed shadow roots
scenarios.workflow: Discover actual iframe button -> click ref and observe one trusted event -> discover open and closed shadow buttons -> one trusted event each -> click iframe by html id -> inspect exact event ledger and rendered screenshot
scenarios.user_problem: Shared hit-target validation must handle real nested documents and shadow roots without refusing valid controls or sending input to another target.

scenarios.name: cdp_nested_hit_targets
scenarios.title: Preserve trusted clicks in scaled iframes and open/closed shadow roots
scenarios.workflow: Discover actual iframe button -> click ref and observe one trusted event -> discover open and closed shadow buttons -> one trusted event each -> click iframe by html id -> inspect exact event ledger and rendered screenshot
scenarios.user_problem: Shared hit-target validation must handle real nested documents and shadow roots without refusing valid controls or sending input to another target.
